subject: Request: trial extension & credits for model evaluation
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@clearpath.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: trial extension & credits for model evaluation

Hi Karthik,

We signed up for Redwood last week (self-serve) to evaluate a mixed workflow: dense embeddings for semantic search + chat completions with long-context documents. The product looks promising, but we hit our free credit cap earlier than expected while running distributed evals across several datasets.

Quick context: ClearPath AI is building a knowledge assistant that ingests multi-page technical docs (avg 25k tokens/doc) and runs retrieval-augmented generation across ~30k docs. We're currently benchmarking 3 model families and expect to need additional tokens to finish a full comparison.

Can you help with: 1) a short trial extension (2–4 weeks) and 2) an additional allotment of free credits (we'd need roughly 500k tokens to finish the run).

I've attached a small usage snapshot showing which endpoints consumed the credits. Happy to share more details if needed. We're evaluating Redwood alongside two other providers and hope to make a decision in the next 3–4 weeks.

Thanks — appreciate any help.

—Olivia Grant
Head of Platform
ClearPath AI
olivia@clearpath.ai
Attachment: usage_snapshot.csv (csv, 12KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: trial extension & credits for model evaluation

Hi Olivia — thanks for the context and the snapshot, that helps. I'm looping in Marissa and Rishi so we can align on the right amount and any GTM follow-up. A couple of quick clarifying questions so we can triage fast: 

- Do you have a targeted decision date (you mentioned 3–4 weeks; is there a hard deadline)?
- Which Redwood endpoints are you hitting most (embeddings vs. chat/generation) and roughly how many calls per hour at peak?
- Is the data you're sending to Redwood PII-sensitive or covered by an NDA/compliance requirement?

Operationally, we can do a provisional credit push and a short extension — we typically require a short evaluation plan (one-paragraph timeline + expected token consumption) so we can track regressions and measure impact. I've attached the internal credit policy for reference.

If you can reply with the above this morning, we should be able to make a decision by end of day and get credits applied.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, PLG
Redwood Inference
Attachment: credit-policy.pdf (pdf, 95KB)

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Thanks Karthik — answers below and a couple more notes.

- Decision timeline: we aim to pick a vendor by 2025-05-09 (about 4 weeks). Hard deadline is the end of May if the pilot needs more time.
- Usage breakdown (approx): embeddings 65% of tokens, chat/generation 35%. Peak calls: embeddings 1200 calls/hour, chat 180 calls/hour.
- Data sensitivity: docs contain technical product specs (no customer PII). We have an NDA with our procurement team but not with Redwood yet — happy to sign a mutual NDA if needed.

Expected consumption to finish benchmarks: ~450k–550k tokens (mostly embedding units). Timeline: 2 weeks to finish the large batch runs if we get an extension today.

Repo and notes: https://github.com/clearpath-ai/rw-eval (private, can share access). I've also attached an architecture snapshot that shows where Redwood fits in our pipeline.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Olivia
Attachment: architecture-diagram.png (png, 180KB)

Hi Olivia — quick update and next steps.

We reviewed this internally and are able to offer a provisional extension + credits to finish your benchmark:

- Provision: 2-week trial extension (new access window until 2025-04-25)
- Credits: 250,000 free tokens applied immediately to your account (promo code applied server-side)

Notes/conditions: the credit is a one-time allotment for evaluation only. If you need the full 500k estimate, we can consider a top-up contingent on a short mutual action plan and a follow-up call with Marissa to discuss GTM/POC scope. Also: please sign the mutual NDA we just sent to the email on file so we can exchange more infra details.

Operationally I'll: 1) open HubSpot ticket HC-9321 and attach your usage snapshot, 2) apply the promo on the billing profile, and 3) share activation steps (attached). Marissa — can you pick a time next week for a 30-min sync if ClearPath wants to review onboarding?

Olivia — confirm you received the credits today and that the account shows the new token balance. If anything looks off I'll escalate to ops.

Best,
